roleOperatorHint: Sees everything: your profile, photo, transcripts and desktop. For the devices you work on yourself.
roleWorkshopHint: Publishes its sessions, receives its notes and reads your context for agents. For the devices that run agents.
roleDisplayHint: Summary only: agents, states and how many things need you. It writes nothing.
refusalConfirmRequired: To make it Operator, type its name exactly as shown.
refusalRevoked: This device is revoked: pair it again with an invitation.
refusalHubItself: This Mac is the hub: it's always Operator and can't be revoked.
refusalForbiddenOrigin: This can only be changed from this Mac.
refusalUnknownInvite: That invitation is no longer pending: it was used, expired or was already cancelled.
logEmpty: This device hasn't read or written anything yet.
versionBehindTitle: Runs a different version from this Mac. Update it with harbard update
operatorWarning: {strong}: your profile and photo, transcripts, live views and desktop. Only give it to a device you work on yourself.
revokeConfirm: Revoke {name}? It stops working on its next request. Other devices are left alone. To use it again you'll need a new invitation.
invitesHint: If a pairing line has leaked, cancel it: it stops working at once.
sectionHint: Each device has its own key. A new one joins as Workshop; Operator is given on purpose.
unreachable: harbard isn't responding; devices can't be shown right now.
onlyThisMac: Only this Mac. To add another, run this in the Terminal on this Mac: {command}
reasonTurnEnded: finished its turn and is waiting
reasonDoneSent: sent DONE and finished its turn
reasonFinished: Claude Code marks it as finished
reasonTaskStop: the lead stopped it with TaskStop
reasonApiError: its last turn ended in an API error
reasonNoRecords: its transcript has no recognisable records
warnTwoWriters: {list} are writing to the same checkout {since}.
warnTwoWritersCheckout: {list} are writing to the same checkout, {checkout}, {since}.
warnBlocked: {who} has been blocked {since} and nobody has answered.
warnUnlabeledOne: {who} sent {count} unlabelled message (START, BLOCKED, FINDING or DONE); the first {at}.
warnUnlabeledMany: {who} sent {count} unlabelled messages (START, BLOCKED, FINDING or DONE); the first {at}.
warnRepeatOne: {who} sent the same message twice; the repeat came {at}.
warnRepeatMany: {who} repeated {count} messages word for word; the first {at}.
depConsumed: Recorded follow-up of a dependency result
